timeline.work: Source 3–5 batches from food-grade mills; composite sampling; gate tests
timeline.decision_gate: Proceed only after lot identity, process records and required safety evidence are accepted.

timeline.work: Bench trials of up to two eligible, evidence-supported candidates; assay before and after
timeline.output: Transferred evidence replaced by measured (grade A)
timeline.decision_gate: Continue only if an eligible candidate improves the measured constraint and reconciles protein/mass balance.

timeline.work: Sensory panel (triangle test + scaling); solubility, emulsification, gelation
timeline.output: Off-flavour index and functionality flags calibrated
timeline.decision_gate: Hold until application-specific functionality and sensory acceptance are demonstrated.

timeline.work: Pilot-scale run (≈ 10 t cake decision volume) with a contract processor or institute pilot plant; micro and contaminants
timeline.decision_gate: Continue scale-up only if the pilot meets the product specification and records yields, losses, utilities and costs.

timeline.work: Re-run the engine with measured data; customer sample trials; regulatory classification check
timeline.output: Updated ₹/kg protein vs pea; go / no-go for a plant
timeline.decision_gate: Approve further development only after customer, regulatory and comparable economic review; otherwise hold or stop.

limitations: Inputs are sampled independently (no correlations between inputs).
Functionality fit (solubility, emulsification, gelation) is a qualitative flag, not a computed score.
Protein is reported crude protein with its recorded laboratory factor, not corrected to true/digestible protein using a generic oilseed N factor.
Costs are lower bounds: missing QA cost, capital, chemicals, energy, labour, overhead, raw material price, water inputs are excluded.
Off-flavour index not computable: no sensory baseline data for this by-product.

Treatments not considered: stabilise (no listed effect on this by-product); moist_heat (no listed effect on this by-product); phytase (no listed effect on this by-product); soak_germinate (no listed effect on this by-product); ssf_ferment (no listed effect on this by-product); ethanol_wash (no listed effect on this by-product)
This is a proof of concept; the next step is laboratory validation.
Economic VOI is not estimated: complete process costs, calibrated distributions and actual laboratory quotes are required. Critical safety tests remain necessary independently of economic VOI.
Oilseed references are secondary/review-reported unless stated otherwise; their reported ranges are not batch assays.
Cost boundary excludes unsupplied transport/storage, preprocessing, drying/separation, packaging/logistics and waste treatment; partial costs are lower bounds, not full production costs.
Pea price, freight, exchange rate and import charges form an illustrative scenario, not a current verified supplier quote or customs ruling.
disclaimer: Proof of concept. Not a substitute for laboratory validation. Decision support only. Not a regulatory approval. Confirm FSSAI classification and limits.

safety.note: Aflatoxins (B1 and total): TEST-FIRST; Heavy metals: TEST-FIRST; Solvent residue: TEST-FIRST; Food-grade provenance: TEST-FIRST; Regulatory: TEST-FIRST

technical.note: Protein concentration, retention and application-specific functionality need batch validation; candidate routes are not industrial predictions.

economic.note: Only comparable complete costs can establish target compliance. Partial costs cannot establish commercial viability.

evidence.note: References, assumptions and batch measurements remain separate. Primary-source and pilot validation are outstanding.

functional_comparison.note: Reference comparison only: whole-cake flour and extracted isolates are separate matrices. Qi et al. (2025) used commercial PPI with 80.2% protein and studied gellan gum/NaCl formulations. The paper is not a head-to-head oilseed study, so no winner, numerical superiority, or batch-level functional score can be inferred.
